plugins.description: Opt-in Claude Code mods for crux: a run dashboard that shows the active promptbook run above the prompt and in a /crux-dashboard pane. crux-mods reads the text and origin kind of every prompt you submit, keeps none of it, and stops reading when read_prompts is off.
